topics.title: No article? Add "a" or "the"
topics.titleFa: حرف تعریف را جا نیندازید: a / an / the

teach.en: Persian has no word like "a" or "the", so we often drop them in English. Let's fix that today.
teach.fa: فارسی کلمه‌ای مثل a یا the ندارد؛ برای همین در انگلیسی جا می‌اندازیم. امروز درستش می‌کنیم.

teach.en: Jobs need "a" or "an": not "I am teacher", but "I'm a teacher".
teach.fa: برای شغل a یا an لازم است: نه I am teacher، بلکه I'm a teacher.

teach.en: Use "the" when we both know which one: "Close the door, please."
teach.fa: وقتی هر دو می‌دانیم کدام است the می‌گوییم: Close the door, please.

teach.en: Use "an" before a vowel sound: an apple, an hour. Use "a" before a consonant sound: a university.
teach.fa: قبل از صدای مصوت an (an hour) و قبل از صدای صامت a (a university).

examples.en: My husband is a builder.
Can you open the window?
I waited an hour at the GP surgery.
examples.fa: یک ساعت در درمانگاه منتظر ماندم.

practice.prompt: We live in ___ flat near the station.

answers: She goes to a university in Leeds.
She goes to an university in Leeds.
She goes to university the in Leeds.

practice.prompt: Add the missing article: "I am student."
Add the missing article: "She bought umbrella."

test.prompt: I'm a cleaner at the hospital.
answers: I'm a cleaner at the hospital.

test.prompt: Add the missing article: "He is cook."

topics.title: "He" or "she"? Not the same!
topics.titleFa: he یا she؟ «او» در انگلیسی دوتاست

teach.en: In Persian, one word, "u", means both he and she. In English we must choose.
teach.fa: در فارسی «او» هم برای مرد است هم زن؛ در انگلیسی باید انتخاب کنیم.

teach.en: A man is "he", "him", "his". A woman is "she", "her", "her".
teach.fa: مرد: he، him، his. زن: she، her، her.

teach.en: A thing or an animal we don't know is "it", "its".
teach.fa: چیز یا حیوان: it و its.

teach.en: Tip: before you say it, think — man or woman? Then pick the word.
teach.fa: نکته: قبل از گفتن فکر کنید مرد است یا زن، بعد کلمه را انتخاب کنید.

examples.en: My sister is a dentist. She works in Croydon.
examples.fa: خواهرم دندانپزشک است. او در کرویدن کار می‌کند.

examples.en: Tom loves his bus.
I called my mum and told her the news.
examples.fa: به مادرم زنگ زدم و خبر را به او گفتم.

practice.prompt: My wife is tired. ___ works nights.
I saw William and gave ___ the book.

answers: My mother lives with her sister.
My mother lives with his sister.
My mother lives with he sister.
Ryan is late. He missed his bus.
Ryan is late. She missed her bus.
Ryan is late. He missed her bus.

practice.prompt: Fix it (talking about a woman): "He is my manager, his name is Sara."
answers: She is my manager, her name is Sara.
She's my manager, her name is Sara.
She's my manager. Her name is Sara.

practice.prompt: Fix it (Ali is a man): "Ali lost her phone."

answers: Ali's mum is a teacher. She teaches maths.
Ali's mum is a teacher. He teaches maths.
Ali's mum is a teacher. His teaches maths.

test.prompt: Your uncle is here. ___ is waiting outside.

teach.en: Persian puts the verb at the end. English puts it right after the subject.
teach.fa: فارسی فعل را آخر جمله می‌گذارد؛ انگلیسی درست بعد از فاعل.

teach.en: Not "I English study", but "I study English".
teach.fa: نه I English study، بلکه I study English.

teach.en: Adjectives go before the noun: "a red car", not "a car red".
teach.fa: صفت قبل از اسم می‌آید: a red car، نه a car red.

teach.en: Time usually goes at the end: "I go to work every day."
teach.fa: زمان معمولاً آخر جمله می‌آید: I go to work every day.

examples.en: I bought a new coat yesterday.
She speaks English very well.
examples.fa: او انگلیسی را خیلی خوب صحبت می‌کند.

examples.en: We visited my aunt last weekend.
examples.fa: آخر هفتهٔ پیش به خاله‌ام سر زدیم.

practice.prompt: We watch TV in the evening.
answers: We watch TV in the evening.

practice.prompt: My son plays football on Saturdays.
answers: My son plays football on Saturdays.
I like British food very much.
I like very much British food.
I very much like food British.
They live in a small flat.
They in a small flat live.
They live in a flat small.

practice.prompt: Fix the order: "I my keys lost."
Fix the order: "She a dress red bought."
Can you help me with this form?
answers: Can you help me with this form?

test.prompt: I go to the gym twice a week.
answers: I go to the gym twice a week.
I saw an old friend yesterday.
I yesterday saw a friend old.
I an old friend saw yesterday.

teach.en: In Persian a question can sound just like a statement. In English we change the words.
teach.fa: در فارسی سؤال گاهی فقط با لحن است؛ در انگلیسی ساختار جمله عوض می‌شود.

teach.en: With "be" and "can", swap them: "You are ready" becomes "Are you ready?"
teach.fa: با be و can جایشان را عوض کنید: Are you ready?

teach.en: With other verbs, add "do" or "does": "Where do you live?", not "Where you live?"
teach.fa: با فعل‌های دیگر do یا does اضافه کنید: Where do you live?

teach.en: After "does", the verb has no -s: "Does she work?", not "Does she works?"
teach.fa: بعد از does فعل s نمی‌گیرد: Does she work?

examples.en: Where do you work?
Does your son go to school?
Can I pay by card?

practice.prompt: Make a question: "She lives in Leeds."

test.prompt: Make a question: "He works on Sundays."
Where can I park my car?
answers: Where can I park my car?

topics.title: "I'm 30", not "I have 30 years"
topics.titleFa: I'm 30 نه I have 30 years — be و have

teach.en: Some Persian phrases use "have" where English uses "be", and the other way round.
teach.fa: بعضی عبارت‌ها در فارسی با «داشتن» است ولی در انگلیسی با be، و برعکس.

teach.en: Age uses "be": "I'm thirty", not "I have thirty years".
teach.fa: سن با be: I'm thirty، نه I have thirty years.

teach.en: Feelings like "agree" are verbs: "I agree", not "I am agree".
teach.fa: agree فعل است: I agree، نه I am agree.

teach.en: But: "I'm hungry", "I'm cold", "I'm right" — these use "be".
teach.fa: ولی: I'm hungry، I'm cold، I'm right با be هستند.

examples.en: My daughter is seven.
I agree with you.
I'm cold. Can you close the window?

answers: How many years do you have?

topics.title: Plurals: "two books", no "informations"
topics.titleFa: جمع: two books — و information بدون s

teach.en: In Persian, after a number the noun stays singular: "do ketab". In English we add -s: "two books".
teach.fa: در فارسی بعد از عدد اسم مفرد می‌ماند (دو کتاب)؛ در انگلیسی s می‌گیرد: two books.

teach.en: Some words never take -s: information, advice, furniture, luggage, homework, news.
teach.fa: بعضی اسم‌ها هرگز s نمی‌گیرند: information، advice، furniture، luggage، homework، news.

teach.en: For these, say "some advice" or "a piece of advice", and use "much", not "many".
teach.fa: برای این‌ها بگویید some advice یا a piece of advice، و much نه many.

teach.en: "People" is already plural: "people are", not "peoples is".
teach.fa: people خودش جمع است: people are.

examples.en: I have three children.
Can you give me some information?
The news is good today.

answers: She gave me some good advice.
She gave me some good advices.

practice.prompt: There are five ___ in the room.
My son has a lot of ___ tonight.
Can I have two coffees, please?
answers: Can I have two coffees, please?

practice.prompt: The news is on at six.
answers: The news is on at six.
Let me give you some advice.
Let me give you some advices.
Let me give you an advice.

topics.title: Prepositions: in, on, at, to, with
topics.titleFa: حرف اضافه: in، on، at، to، with

teach.en: Prepositions don't match Persian one-to-one, so learn them in chunks.
teach.fa: حرف اضافه‌ها یک‌به‌یک با فارسی جور نیستند؛ آن‌ها را تکه‌تکه حفظ کنید.

teach.en: Time: at 9 o'clock, on Monday, in June, in the morning, at the weekend.
teach.fa: زمان: at 9، on Monday، in June، in the morning، at the weekend.

teach.en: Common chunks: married to, angry with, depend on, listen to, wait for.
teach.fa: تکه‌های رایج: married to، angry with، depend on، listen to، wait for.

teach.en: Not "married with", not "depend to", not "listen music".
teach.fa: نه married with، نه depend to، نه listen music.

examples.en: My appointment is on Tuesday at ten.
examples.fa: وقت من سه‌شنبه ساعت ده است.

examples.en: She's married to a Scottish man.
examples.fa: او با یک مرد اسکاتلندی ازدواج کرده.

examples.en: I'm waiting for the bus.

practice.prompt: I'll see you at the weekend.
answers: I'll see you at the weekend.

practice.prompt: Fix it: "I am waiting the train."
answers: I am waiting for the train.

practice.prompt: Fix it: "He is married with Sara."

test.prompt: Fix it: "I listen music every day."
answers: I listen to music every day.

topics.title: Past and present perfect: "I've lived here since…"

teach.en: Persian often uses the present for something that started in the past. English uses the present perfect.
teach.fa: فارسی برای کاری که از گذشته شروع شده گاهی حال می‌گوید؛ انگلیسی حال کامل.

teach.en: Not "I live here since 2020", but "I've lived here since 2020".
teach.fa: نه I live here since 2020، بلکه I've lived here since 2020.

teach.en: With a finished time (yesterday, last week, in 2019) use the past: "I went yesterday".
teach.fa: با زمان تمام‌شده (yesterday، last week) گذشتهٔ ساده: I went yesterday.

teach.en: Not "Yesterday I go": the verb must change — went, saw, bought.
teach.fa: نه Yesterday I go؛ فعل عوض می‌شود: went، saw، bought.

examples.en: I've lived in London for five years.
examples.fa: پنج سال است در لندن زندگی می‌کنم.

examples.en: I saw the doctor last Monday.
Have you ever been to Scotland?

answers: I am working here since May.

practice.prompt: She ___ in the UK for three years.

answers: I bought this coat last week.
I have bought this coat last week.
I buy this coat last week.
How long have you been here?

practice.prompt: We moved here two years ago.
answers: We moved here two years ago.

practice.prompt: ___ you ever tried fish and chips?
Fix it: "Yesterday I see my friend."

answers: I've known her for ten years.
I know her for ten years.
I am knowing her for ten years.

test.prompt: Fix it: "Last week I buy a car."
answers: Last week I bought a car.

topics.title: Sounds: w/v, th, and no extra "e"
topics.titleFa: تلفظ: w و v، صدای th، و «اِ» اضافه نگذارید

teach.en: Persian has one sound between "w" and "v". In English they change the meaning: wine and vine.
teach.fa: فارسی بین w و v یک صدا دارد؛ در انگلیسی معنی را عوض می‌کنند: wine و vine.

teach.en: For "w", round your lips like a kiss. For "v", touch your top teeth on your bottom lip.
teach.fa: برای w لب‌ها را غنچه کنید؛ برای v دندان بالا را روی لب پایین بگذارید.

teach.en: For "th", put your tongue between your teeth: think, three, this, mother.
teach.fa: برای th زبان را بین دندان‌ها بگذارید: think، three، this.

teach.en: Don't add a vowel before "s": say "school", "station", "Spain" — not "eschool", "estation".
teach.fa: قبل از s صدای «اِ» نگذارید: school نه اِسکول، station نه اِستیشن.

examples.en: We went to the west of Wales.
I think there are three of them.
The station is near my school.

practice.prompt: Which word is a drink made from grapes?
Which word means the opposite of "thin"?
A car has four of these. Which word?
Our cat went to the ___ for an injection.
Write the number that comes after two (in letters):
We visited Wales in the winter.
answers: We visited Wales in the winter.

test.prompt: Which word is a big group of water moving to the beach?
Which word means a road you can drive on? (lips rounded)
Which word is the day after Wednesday?
Three of us went to the west.
answers: Three of us went to the west.

topics.title: Sounding polite: "Could I…?" not "Give me"
topics.titleFa: مؤدبانه حرف زدن: Could I… به‌جای Give me

teach.en: A direct order can sound rude in British English, even when you don't mean it.
teach.fa: در انگلیسی بریتانیایی دستور مستقیم حتی بی‌منظور هم بی‌ادبانه به نظر می‌رسد.

teach.en: Not "Give me a coffee", but "Could I have a coffee, please?"
teach.fa: نه Give me a coffee، بلکه Could I have a coffee, please?

teach.en: Use "please", "thank you", and "sorry" a lot — more than in Persian.
teach.fa: please، thank you و sorry را زیاد بگویید؛ بیشتر از فارسی.

teach.en: To ask for help: "Could you…?", "Would you mind…?", "Excuse me, …"
teach.fa: برای کمک خواستن: Could you…؟، Would you mind…؟، Excuse me…

examples.en: Could I have a glass of water, please?
examples.fa: می‌شود یک لیوان آب بدهید، لطفاً؟

examples.en: Excuse me, could you help me?
Would you mind opening the window?
examples.fa: زحمت می‌کشید پنجره را باز کنید؟

answers: Could I have the bill, please?
Excuse me, where is the toilet?
Would you mind waiting a moment?

Could you say that again, please?
answers: Could you say that again, please?

practice.prompt: Could I have a coffee, please?
answers: Could I have a coffee, please?

practice.prompt: Make it polite: "Give me a ticket."
answers: Could I have a ticket, please?
Can I have a ticket, please?

answers: Excuse me, could you help me?
